classification: SYNTHETIC NONPROD UAT FIXTURE. Every record is marked SYNTHETIC UAT. Nothing here touches Taylor data, production or Firebase. No credential, token or secret is in this file.

prerequisites.text: The Ventana operating-company KEY is bound: eos_policy.tenant_operating_company_keys holds an ACTIVE row for (tenant, ventana). Governed path: add the binding to config/ownership/operating-company-keys.sandbox.json (a controller PR; Owner question OQ-09), then run scripts/tenantOperatingCompanyKeyReconcileCli.js --apply on the Render shell. This script never writes it; it detects an unbound key from the refusal OPERATING_COMPANY_NOT_GOVERNED and stops.
PR #2201 (persona harness allowlist) is merged and deployed, so the guarded transport is in force. This script also performs its own exact-match target check and refuses any other base URL.
EOS_PERSONA_ISSUER_CREDENTIAL is set by the operator (name only; never printed). The issuer is used here as an API client for governed Administration and business commands, not as login proof.
